snippet.title: Mage Mail Trailer
snippet.description:
In this party game for 1-4 players, you must work together to package items and send them off. Using the variety of stations in your post office basement, you need to work quickly and precisely to send off as many parcels as possible within the time limit. Items come in all shapes and sizes, and each needs different treatment. Don’t do the wrong thing or you’ll be penalised by the owners of the business!

Music from geoffharvey on Pixabay
